explanation: D2 is always high: about 9 after choosing a2 (10 if the transition was rare), and about 7-8 after choosing a1 (4-6 if rare). GO is low: about 0 for a1 after a reward, 1-2 for a1 after no reward, and 4-5 for a2 (6-8 after several unrewarded a2 trials in a row); D1 is about 7 (8-9 after a reward streak) when the previous trial was rewarded, about 6-7 when unrewarded and the agent has been choosing a2, and 0-2 when unrewarded and the agent has been choosing a1.
